svg.title: Lorca model decisions, tool authorization, and context management
svg.desc: The Rust runtime prepares a request for the local model. The model can use a tool, recall original records, ask the user, or finish. Tool results and recalled records update working context. The harness checkpoints under context pressure before returning to the model.
